criteria.description: validate() merges the UA's own validity flags from the inner control with the flags the element derives, rather than replacing them.
criteria.evidence: fixtures/elements-behaviour/src/sk-form-input.test.ts: '[SC-003] a merged UA validity flag blocks a real submit and carries a message — mount-time', '...a constraint attribute changed AFTER mount reaches the host validity — the read-before-write ordering fix', '...a `type` change and a `value` change in the SAME update validate against the NEW type — the probe-ordering fix', '...a UA flag with no required/customError still gets a non-empty message — the setValidity throw fix', '...badInput reaches the host — REAL typing only, never a property assignment', '...a bad-input control keeps the user's buffer, rather than being overwritten mid-edit'. mutations.json carries 11 SC-003 arms for this element, including three added in the pre-merge debugger fold (probe ordering, null-vs-undefined, whitespace customError). Operator ruling (research.md R9) additionally added: '[SC-003] a value the current type cannot represent blocks a real submit — the programmatic badInput divergence (operator ruling)' (type="date", value="2026-13-45"), '[SC-003] a comma-formatted number blocks a real submit — the programmatic badInput divergence (operator ruling)' (type="number", value="1,5"), and the negative '[SC-003] an unparseable-looking but non-sanitizing value reports typeMismatch, NOT the new divergence — proves the branch does not over-fire' (type="email", value="notanemail"). mutations.json gained one more SC-003 arm for the new branch.
criteria.verified_by: ci @ 33991913077 (cde2fb8, pre-merge gate pass 1) + local verification (debugger-fold round, #180)
criteria.notes: DEVIATION, documented: tooLong/tooShort are named in this FR's text but are deliberately NOT in the merge list — research.md R2 finding 3 records why (they require maxlength/minlength, which this mission does not forward, so their mutation arms would be permanently inert). All five reachable UA flags (patternMismatch, rangeUnderflow, rangeOverflow, stepMismatch, typeMismatch) plus badInput are merged and covered. The value-authority fork the debugger lens raised (raw vs. sanitized value, and whether valueMissing should rebase on the sanitized string) is now RESOLVED by explicit operator ruling, not by implementer judgement: setFormValue stays raw (unchanged contract), a type-cannot-represent divergence is detected and blocks submission as a badInput analogue, and the sanitized-submission / sanitized-valueMissing options were explicitly declined as out of this mission's scope (see research.md R9 in full).

criteria.description: readonly matches platform semantics: the value IS submitted (setFormValue(this.value)), and the control is barred from constraint validation (setValidity({})) — same validation outcome as disabled, opposite submission outcome.
criteria.evidence: fixtures/elements-behaviour/src/sk-form-input.test.ts '[SC-002][SC-003] a readonly control still submits but is barred from constraint validation' and '[SC-003] readonly reaches the inner control but is NOT reflected on the host'. research.md R1 records the measured platform table (readonly barred from constraint validation on the attribute alone, both engines) that this design is built against.
criteria.verified_by: ci @ 33991913077 (cde2fb8, pre-merge gate pass 1) + local verification (debugger-fold round, #180)
criteria.notes: readonly is deliberately unreflected (R1) — the property still reaches the inner control via the property binding in render(), matching the disabled precedent for the same SC-005-shaped mutation-observability reason.
